name: 謝心心
objective:
本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
授課教師保留依實際教學現況、學生學習成效、設備狀態及不可抗力因素，適度調整評分方式、比例與課程內容之權利。
The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.
The instructor reserves the right to modify the grading criteria, percentages, and course content based on actual class performance, student progress, equipment availability, or force majeure.
schedule:
週次排定進度為預定計畫。教師得依班級實際學習進度、實驗室機台現況及天災停課等實務需求，彈性調整或變更授課時程。


The weekly schedule is tentative and subject to change. The instructor reserves the right to adjust or reorder topics and lab sessions based on actual class progress, lab equipment status, or unexpected circumstances.
scorePolicy:
為因應實際教學情況，教師保留適度調整評分方式與比例之權利。

To accommodate actual teaching needs, the instructor reserves the right to make appropriate adjustments to the grading methods and weight distribution.
materials: University physics with Modern physics. 15 edition ;H. D Young & R. A Freedman.
consultation: 期中考 45% 期末考 45% 出席 & 作業 10%
